chapter: New York bands and the first records
title: Charlie Barnet's little band
summary: He shares a band with Charlie Barnet, taking turns as leader, and plays piano while studying harmony.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Oh, yeah, we became good friends after that. But, then after that I jobbed around and jobbed around then --

-- and we had -- we had a little band together. In other words, if I got a job, he set down and if he got a job I set down and played piano at that time. I was makeying around with piano, cause I was studying harmony.
And -- it was nice, it was nice there. We had some good men in the band.
Charlie hadn't had a band very long at that time, had he?
He had a short time at the Paramount Hotel, which was -- didn't last very long.
Then he was out in New Jersey somewhere--
